skill.name: programmatic-seo
skill.description: Design and evaluate programmatic SEO strategies for search-driven pages at scale using templates, structured data, and indexation controls.
skill.summary: Plan programmatic SEO systems with feasibility scoring, template design, and quality controls.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive. The phrase "Avoid crawl traps" appears in SEO crawl management guidance, not system reconnaissance or host discovery.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 286 says "Avoid crawl traps" inside an SEO crawl management section. This refers to search engine crawl control, not system reconnaissance.

content.user_title: Plan Programmatic SEO Pages at Scale
content.value_statement: Programmatic SEO can create thin pages when teams scale keyword patterns without validation. This skill scores feasibility and designs page systems with data, templates, and index controls.
actual_capabilities: Calculate a 0-100 Feasibility Index with weighted category rationale.
Assess keyword patterns, page scale, competition, and search intent alignment.
Define data requirements, template sections, conditional logic, and indexation rules.
Identify thin content, duplicate page, crawl, and indexation risks.
Provide quality gates, kill switch criteria, and mitigation plans.
limitations: Does not fetch live search volume or ranking data unless another tool is used.
Does not implement pages, schemas, or crawlers unless explicitly requested.
Cannot guarantee rankings or traffic outcomes.
Requires accurate business, keyword, and data source context from the user.

use_cases.title: Validate an SEO Expansion Idea
use_cases.description: Score a proposed page pattern before investing in templates, data pipelines, or content operations.

use_cases.title: Design a Scalable Page System
use_cases.description: Turn a qualified keyword pattern into URL rules, data needs, template sections, and quality gates.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Growth Page Types
use_cases.description: Compare locations, integrations, comparisons, directories, and profiles by feasibility, risk, and business value.

prompt_templates.title: Score an Idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate my programmatic SEO idea for [business]. The page pattern is [pattern]. Data sources are [sources]. Calculate the Feasibility Index and explain the verdict.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Page System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a programmatic SEO page system for [pattern]. Include URL structure, template sections, data requirements, internal links, and indexation criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build Index Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Create index and noindex rules for these generated pages: [page types]. Include quality gates, crawl controls, sitemap segmentation, and monitoring signals.

prompt_templates.title: Stress Test a Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this programmatic SEO plan: [plan]. Find thin content, duplicate intent, crawl, data quality, and suppression risks. Recommend launch limits and kill switches.

output_examples.input: A SaaS company wants pages for best CRM for each industry.
output_examples.output: Feasibility Index: 72/100. Proceed with scope limits. The plan needs industry-specific data, comparison criteria, and noindex rules for weak segments.

output_examples.input: A marketplace wants location pages using public listings.
output_examples.output: The system should index only cities with enough listings, demand, and unique local value. Thin markets should remain noindexed.

output_examples.input: A startup wants 20,000 AI-generated glossary pages.
output_examples.output: Verdict: Do Not Proceed. The pattern has high duplication risk and weak unique value. Build fewer expert pages instead.

best_practices: Start with the Feasibility Index before choosing templates or page counts.
Use proprietary or product-derived data whenever possible.
Index only pages with demand, unique value, and complete intent coverage.
anti_patterns: Do not create pages by swapping variables without adding unique value.
Do not index every generated URL by default.
Do not use programmatic pages when one editorial guide satisfies the intent.

faq.question: What does this skill help me decide?
faq.answer: It helps decide whether programmatic SEO is a good fit and how to design the page system.

faq.question: Can it generate the pages for me?
faq.answer: It focuses on strategy and system design. It implements pages only when you explicitly request implementation.

faq.question: Does it use live SEO data?
faq.answer: Not by itself. Provide keyword, ranking, or analytics data for more accurate recommendations.

faq.question: How does it reduce thin content risk?
faq.answer: It checks unique value, data quality, intent completeness, duplicate risk, and indexation controls.

faq.question: Which page types does it support?
faq.answer: It covers templates, directories, locations, comparisons, integrations, profiles, examples, glossary pages, and similar patterns.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
